objective: Package the existing one-zone SmartFarm simulator as a reproducible CoreIoT baseline evidence run.

simulated: Raspberry Pi gateway role on Windows laptop

pass_conditions: All three device telemetry posts return HTTP 2xx for every completed tick.
Moisture below minMoisture triggers START_IRRIGATION and valveState ON.
pulseCounter increases only while the valve is ON.
Moisture reaching targetMoisture triggers STOP_IRRIGATION and valveState OFF.
CoreIoT latest telemetry or timeline shows the run values for all three device targets.
The evidence bundle contains no .env file, access token, or secret.
limitations: The physical sensors, valve, water meter and Raspberry Pi are simulated.
This baseline proves one-zone SIM+PLATFORM integration; multi-zone scheduling and safety scenarios are later backlog items.
